scientific_question: At a true-float64 positive one-sided EqProp operating point, how many nominal bits in an ideal ADC transfer function are required to preserve each minibatch weight-gradient update when the matched zero and positive endpoint states are read separately, and how much does an optimistic analog-differential front end reduce that requirement?

source.accepted_operating_point: trained Conv3 legacy, native T=K=8, frozen-current positive one-sided EqProp; no T/K recalibration

cohort.source: reuse the exact completed native-beta cohort

dynamics.zero_endpoint: explicit beta=0 K-step endpoint restored from the common post-T state
dynamics.positive_endpoint: positive beta K-step endpoint independently restored from the identical common post-T state

adc.absolute_range_calibration: per-layer maximum absolute matched-zero endpoint over all 64 examples, multiplied by headroom; one range and code grid frozen across both phases, all betas, and all minibatches
adc.differential_range_calibration: optimistic per-layer and per-beta maximum absolute s_plus-s_zero over all 64 examples, multiplied by headroom; the ideal common state is retained exactly
adc.threshold_selection: report the first nominal bit depth that passes and remains passing at every higher tested integer bit; refine every integer from the last lower coarse point through the declared maximum, or from the two-bit quantizer model floor when the lowest coarse point already begins a sustained passing region; expose pass-to-fail reversals and open lower edges
adc.endpoint_statistic_arithmetic: recompute each local squared-voltage-drop statistic from quantized nodes in float64, subtract positive minus zero in float64, then divide by effective beta
adc.interpretation: optimistic same-cohort-calibrated ideal-quantizer diagnostic; nominal bits describe the simulated normalized-state transfer function and are not hardware ENOB. The implemented endpoint-statistic path subtracts in float64, so the primary result includes both ADC quantization and digital cancellation error

gradient_fidelity_gate.reference: unquantized true-float64 EqProp at the identical beta and endpoint dynamics

reported_measurements: quantized EqProp versus clean EqProp cosine, relative L2, norm ratio, symmetric norm delta, and exact-zero fraction
quantized EqProp versus BPTT and clean EqProp versus BPTT, kept separate from acquisition fidelity
per-layer ADC LSB, clipping fraction, endpoint code-change fraction, and displacement-to-LSB quantiles
first sustained passing nominal ideal ADC-bit threshold by beta and acquisition model, with lower-open bounds and pass-to-fail reversals explicit

dac_scope.reason: Weight programming requires a separately declared conductance range, learning-rate/optimizer proposal, programming transfer function, and update accumulation policy. It follows only after an ADC-viable operating point is identified.

execution.production_budget: one local RTX 3090; one checkpoint; four batches; three betas; read-only endpoint replay plus offline quantization; no training
execution.expected_duration: approximately 5-20 minutes after a one-batch semantic smoke
